name: Crucible Industries Storm-12 'Thunderclap'
description:
The Crucible Industries Storm-12 is a semi-automatic shotgun chambered in 12 gauge with a gas-operated action and a seven-round detachable box magazine. The weapon features a full-length Picatinny rail, adjustable stock, and a heavy-profile barrel with an integral breaching muzzle device. Every surface communicates tactical intent — this is not a hunting shotgun repurposed for combat, but a purpose-built combat shotgun from the ground up.

The Thunderclap's gas system is tuned to cycle reliably with everything from light birdshot to heavy magnum slugs without adjustment — a significant engineering achievement that most shotguns require manual gas port adjustment to match. The detachable box magazine allows rapid reloading compared to tube-fed designs, and spare magazines can be carried on standard plate-carrier pouches. The system transforms the shotgun from a slow-reloading specialty weapon into a primary combat arm with practical sustained fire capability.

Crucible Industries markets the Storm-12 to corponation tactical teams and licensed security contractors who need breaching and close-quarters capability. The integral breaching device allows the weapon to be placed against a door hinge and fired to remove the hinge — a specialized function that the Thunderclap performs while remaining a fully functional combat shotgun. This dual-purpose design has made it standard equipment for breach teams throughout GLMZ.
specifications:
caliber: 12 gauge
effective_range: 40 meters (slug), 25 meters (buckshot)
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 7 rounds (detachable box)
weight: 3.6 kg
tactical_use: A combat shotgun designed for breaching and close-quarters operations. The semi-automatic action provides rapid follow-up shots. The detachable magazine enables fast reloading. The integral breaching device allows door-hinge removal without switching weapons. The universal gas system handles all ammunition types without adjustment. Effective as a primary weapon for CQB operations.
cultural_context: The Thunderclap is the weapon that comes through your door. In GLMZ's collective consciousness, the sound of a Storm-12 breaching a hinge is associated with corponation enforcement actions — raids, repossessions, and 'security interventions' that nobody in the target neighborhood requested. The weapon's reputation is functional, efficient, and deeply unwelcome.
story_hooks: A Thunderclap is used to breach a door that turns out to be booby-trapped — the breaching charge detonates a secondary device that kills the breach team. Someone knew exactly which weapon would be used and how.
Crucible Industries recalls a batch of Storm-12s after discovering the gas system has a flaw that causes the weapon to slam-fire — emptying the magazine uncontrollably after the first shot.
physical_description: The Storm-12 is a brutish instrument of matte-black steel and polymer, its full-length upper rail scarred from countless optic mounts. The heavy barrel sits crowned with a breaching muzzle device that looks equally suited to door work or point-blank dispatch, while the adjustable stock shows wear marks from different operator hand positions. Gas tube and carrier group are exposed along the top, a design choice that prioritizes reliability over aesthetics—every component visible, nothing hidden.
